svg.title: coil-fold2-long-straight-3t bore - section 11 of 12, bend URRD, 8 parts on 481x73mm
svg.desc: 1 user unit = 1mm. 10mm square bore in 3mm stock, cut for a 3mm sheet at 0.15mm kerf, so a 16mm block pitch; a block that runs straight is 30mm long and a block that turns is a 16mm cube. Blocks 37-41 of the walk, entering on U and leaving on D, a 3x2 block plate laid flat. Two face plates (mirror images) and the side walls; every part carries the section number only. Inner cuts are the port and come before their outline. black #000000 cuts, blue #0000ff engraves.
